purpose: Machine-readable guardrails for coding agents before they choose an edit target.

branchPolicy.rule: Use the current checked-out branch as observed state. These names describe branch roles; they are not a claim that every agent session is currently on staging.

activeGoals: Extend a canonical capability owner instead of creating a parallel owner.
Keep one chat core with five isolated guide memory scopes.
Move cross-guide context only through explicit handoff or user-directed transfer.
Preserve local-first operation and make hosted-service degradation or failure explicit.
Write or identify a failing executable contract before behavior code whenever the failure can be expressed deterministically.

acceptableFirstArtifacts: end-to-end scenario or executable user-story spec
testFirst.rule: For a behavior change, add or tighten the smallest deterministic executable contract that demonstrates the intended behavior before implementing the behavior, unless an existing failing contract already covers it.

mcp.rule: The developer MCP bridge is a maintainer tool. Any future user-facing external-agent interface requires a separate capability owner, authentication contract, privacy review, and explicit product surface.
